correctness.rationale: Two-round EF pointed type determined by predecessor, current, successor colours and the set of colours among all other vertices; equality of sets of pointed types is necessary and sufficient for rank-two sentences. Far colours require counts truncated at four and the set of cyclic length-three factors. Append-state automaton has four seeds, 758 reachable states, and closing into a cycle yields exactly 48 signature classes, with BFS least-length distribution (4,6,6,9,10,9,4) for lengths 3..9. Independently reconstructed this closure and checked direct cyclic pair profiles for every binary word length 3..12, 8184 words, including all four sharp length-nine witnesses. Completeness for all n depends on the finite-state transfer proof, not cutoff enumeration.
